notes: Calibration only, as README.md requires submission before the full run. Six GPT-6.1 Sol agents at high reasoning effort each personally read and semantically labeled two disjoint batches of 25 papers, using titles and abstracts only. The supplied system_prompt.md and filled user_prompt_template.md were read verbatim and applied within the agent task context; they were not sent as isolated API system/user messages. Agent sampling temperature is not exposed by the collaboration tools, so temperature 0 could not be set or verified; the temperature field is null rather than an invented value. No classifier or external paper content was used. Labels were merged without changing the agents' judgments; the coordinating agent performed structural validation only. No model changes or labeling reruns. The package contains no adjudicated reference labels, so reference agreement and the required go/no-go thresholds cannot yet be assessed. Step 2 (43,480 primary labels and 2,174 independent second-pass labels) has not been run.
